title: Decision: Selling Dropship Division
goals: focus on core business strengths, reduce operational complexity, maximize return on division sale, and ensure smooth transition for existing customers

options.title: Complete Sale to Strategic Buyer
options.description: Sell entire dropship division to established e-commerce company at $12M valuation, including all customers, contracts, and technology

options.title: Private Equity Sale
options.description: Sell to PE firm at $10M with potential earnout based on 2-year performance metrics and continued operational involvement

options.title: Management Buyout
options.description: Allow current division management to purchase the unit at $8M with vendor financing and ongoing technology licensing agreement

options.title: Partial Sale with Joint Venture
options.description: Sell 60% stake while maintaining strategic partnership and shared technology infrastructure for key customers

criteria.title: Financial Terms
criteria.description: Purchase price, payment structure, and potential earnout or royalty arrangements

criteria.title: Customer Impact
criteria.description: Effect on existing customers and likelihood of maintaining current business relationships

criteria.title: Employee Retention
criteria.description: Job security for division employees and retention of key personnel

criteria.title: Technology Separation
criteria.description: Complexity of separating shared systems, data, and infrastructure

criteria.title: Contract Obligations
criteria.description: Ability to transfer or maintain existing supplier and customer contracts

criteria.title: Brand Impact
criteria.description: Effect on company reputation and relationships with remaining business units

criteria.title: Transaction Speed
criteria.description: Expected timeline to close deal and complete transition

criteria.title: Ongoing Liabilities
criteria.description: Potential future obligations, warranties, or guarantees after sale

criteria.title: Competitive Implications
criteria.description: Impact on market position and potential future competition from divested unit
